Gloaming Quarter.name: Gloaming Quarter
Gloaming Quarter.description: The user releases hundreds of small smoked-glass shards across a whole city block for the rest of the scene, each casting a pool of real shade even under floodlights. On any turn the user can step between any two shards' shade on the block, pull a bystander through to safety, or shatter a planted shard so its fragments deal heavy piercing damage and pin the shadows of enemies within a few strides; held back, blunt fragments pin their shadows uncut. Sustaining the swarm parches the user and drains their shadow until they rest. Strain: severe.
